tests.name: Zip Code Preservation (:str)
tests.detail: YON :str type hint preserved in AST: true. Leading zero preserved: true. Roundtrip survived: true. JSON preserves string value (true) but has no type annotation to enforce it.

tests.name: Boolean Coercion Prevention (:bool)
tests.detail: active:bool=true → typeHint=bool: true. name:str="true" → typeHint=str: true. YON annotations prevent coercion. JSON relies on value encoding (true).

tests.name: Int/Float Distinction (:int/:float)
tests.detail: port:int → true, ratio:float → true, count:int → true. Roundtrip preserved: true. Score: 4/4.

tests.name: Self-Describing Type Budget (§9 Characteristic)
tests.detail: YON: 325B with 5 explicit type annotations (:int, :bool). JSON minified: 143B (no types). JSON pretty: 176B (no types). The rationale: "one explicit type annotation eliminates an entire class of downstream inference bugs." Cost: ~182B. Benefit: zero type-coercion errors.
